hindi: हे गौओं को पाने वाले, धन को पाने वाले, सोने को पाने वाले, बीज धारण करने वाले बूँद, लोकों में स्थापित तुम शुद्ध होकर बहो। हे सोम, तुम उत्तम वीरों वाले हो, सब जानने वाले; उस तुम्हारे पास ये मनुष्य स्तुति के साथ बैठते हैं।
english: Flow clear, finder of cows, finder of wealth, finder of gold, bearer of seed, O drop, set in the worlds. You are rich in good heroes, O Soma, all-knowing; near that you these men sit with song.
notes: girema is read girā + ime (ā + i = e): 'with song, these [men]'; the alternative of a verb form 'girema' (we would praise) is not adopted because naraḥ ... āsate already supplies the finite verb. su-vīra as 'rich in good heroes' (bahuvrīhi); 'very heroic' is the alternative. retodhā: retas = seed, generative power.
lines_deva: त्वँ सुवीरो असि सोम विश्ववित्तं त्वा नर उप गिरेम आसते
lines_iast: tva~ suvīro asi soma viśvavittaṃ tvā nara upa girema āsate

hindi: हे सोम, तुम मनुष्यों को देखने वाले हो, सब ओर से; हे शुद्ध होते हुए, हे बलवान, तुम उनके बीच से दौड़ते हो। वह हमारे लिए धन से भरपूर, सोने से भरपूर होकर शुद्ध बहो; हम लोकों में जीने के लिए हों।
english: You are the watcher of men from all sides, O Soma; O clarifying one, O mighty one, you run through those. That one, flow clear for us, rich in wealth, rich in gold; may we be in the worlds in order to live.
notes: tā (f. or n. acc. pl.) has no stated referent; 'run through those' is kept literal. vasumat and hiraṇyavat are neuter accusatives used adverbially.
lines_deva: त्वं नृचक्षा असि सोम विश्वतः पवमान वृषभ ता वि धावसि
स नः पवस्व वसुमद्धिरण्यवद्वयँ स्याम भुवनेषु जीवसे
lines_iast: tvaṃ nṛcakṣā asi soma viśvataḥ pavamāna vṛṣabha tā vi dhāvasi
sa naḥ pavasva vasumaddhiraṇyavadvaya~ syāma bhuvaneṣu jīvase

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √īś
m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √yuj

hindi: इन लोकों पर शासन करते हुए तुम चलते हो, हे बूँद, भूरे सुन्दर पंखों वालों को जोतते हुए। तुम्हारी वे मधुयुक्त घी, दूध बहाएँ; हे सोम, तुम्हारे व्रत में लोग स्थित रहें।
english: Ruling these worlds you go, O drop, yoking the tawny ones, the fair-winged. May those of yours flow honeyed ghee, milk; may the peoples stand in your ordinance, O Soma.
notes: haritaḥ suparṇyaḥ: the nouns they qualify are not stated; suparṇyaḥ looks feminine, haritaḥ may be masculine or feminine, so no noun (such as horses) is added. tāḥ te (f. pl.) has no stated referent. vrata is taken as 'ordinance'.
lines_deva: ईशान इमा भुवनानि ईयसे युजान इन्दो हरितः सुपर्ण्यः
तास्ते क्षरन्तु मधुमद्घृतं पयस्तव व्रते सोम तिष्ठन्तु कृष्टयः
lines_iast: īśāna imā bhuvanāni īyase yujāna indo haritaḥ suparṇyaḥ
tāste kṣarantu madhumadghṛtaṃ payastava vrate soma tiṣṭhantu kṛṣṭayaḥ

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. mid. √pū

hindi: हे सब जानने वाले, शुद्ध होते हुए तुम्हारी धाराएँ आगे छोड़ी गई हैं, सूर्य की किरणों के समान।
english: Of you who are being clarified, O all-knowing, the streams have been released forth, like the rays of the sun.
notes: iva and na both mean 'like'; translated once.

words.gram: m. abl. or gen. sg. (with pari)

hindi: आकाश से ध्वज बनाते हुए तुम सब रूपों की ओर बहते हो; हे सोम, समुद्र तुम उमड़ते हो।
english: Making a banner from heaven, you flow toward all forms; an ocean, O Soma, you swell.

text_flags.why: Possible: a present participle nom. sg. ends in -n before d- (kṛṇvan divas pari); the printed anusvāra is not expected here.

notes: divaspari = divaḥ pari; the case of divaḥ with pari (ablative 'from' or genitive) is not certain. 'samudraḥ' has no iva, so it is rendered as a plain apposition.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pf. part. mid. √jan

hindi: उत्पन्न होते हुए तुम वाणी को आगे भेजते हो, हे शुद्ध होते हुए; देव सूर्य के समान गरजते हुए।
english: Being born, you send forth the voice, O clarifying one, [unclear]; roaring like the god Sūrya.

text_flags.why: Possible: a present participle nom. sg. ends in -n before d- (krandan devo na sūryaḥ); the printed anusvāra is not expected here.

notes: vidharmaṇi is obscure (loc. of vi-dharman, 'in the upholding / support / separation'); left [unclear] in English and omitted in Hindi. iṣyasi from √iṣ 'set in motion', rendered 'send forth'.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. √śrī

hindi: सोम आगे दौड़े हैं, शुद्ध होती हुई बूँदें; जलों में मिलते हुए वे शुद्ध करते हैं।
english: Forth have the Somas run, the clarifying drops; mixing in the waters, they cleanse.
notes: vṛñjate: the printed form is kept and read as √vṛj 'clear, cleanse'; the sense is uncertain.

words.gram: m. nom. pl. pres. part. mid. √pū

hindi: गौएँ अभिमुख होकर दौड़ी हैं, जैसे ढलान से जाते हुए जल; शुद्ध होते हुए उन्होंने इन्द्र को पा लिया है।
english: The cows have run toward, like waters going down a slope; being purified, they have reached Indra.
notes: abhi adhanviṣuḥ is a split verb ('run toward'); the goal is not stated.
lines_deva: अभि गावो अधन्विषुरापो न प्रवता यतीः
lines_iast: abhi gāvo adhanviṣurāpo na pravatā yatīḥ

hindi: हे शुद्ध होते हुए, तुम आगे दौड़ते हो, हे सोम, इन्द्र के लिए आनन्द देने वाले; मनुष्यों द्वारा थामे हुए तुम दूर ले जाए जाते हो।
english: Forth you run, O clarifying one, O Soma, gladdening, for Indra; held by men, you are led away.
notes: vi nīyase can also be 'led apart / led through'; 'led away' is the most literal.

hindi: हे बूँद, जब पत्थरों से निचोड़े हुए तुम छन्ने के चारों ओर उड़ते हो; इन्द्र के धाम के लिए उचित।
english: O drop, when, pressed by the stones, you fly around the filter; fitting for the abode of Indra.
notes: dhāman is rendered 'abode'; 'place' or 'form' are other possible senses. The last four words have no verb.

hindi: हे सोम, तुम मनुष्यों को आनन्द देने वाले, लोगों के आधार, शुद्ध होकर बहो; जो जीतने वाला है, आनन्द मनाने योग्य।
english: You, O Soma, gladdening men, supporter of the peoples, flow clear; the winner who is to be rejoiced in.
notes: yaḥ ... anumādyaḥ is loose syntax; read as 'the winner, who is to be rejoiced in'.

hindi: हे वृत्र के सबसे श्रेष्ठ मारने वाले, शुद्ध होकर बहो, उक्थों से आनन्द मनाने योग्य; शुद्ध, पावन करने वाले, अद्भुत।
english: Flow clear, O best slayer of Vṛtra, to be rejoiced in with recitations; pure, the purifier, wonderful.

hindi: सोम निचोड़ा हुआ शुद्ध पावन करने वाला कहा जाता है; वह मधुयुक्त है, देवगण को चाहने वाला, बुरा चाहने वाले को मारने वाला।
english: Pressed Soma is called the pure purifier; he is honeyed, favouring the gods, slayer of the evil-wisher.
notes: devāvīḥ ('gods-favouring', from √av/√vī) and agha-śaṃsa ('evil-wisher', also 'evil speech') are rendered literally; the sense of devāvī is not fully certain.
lines_deva: शुचिः पावक उच्यते सोमः सुतः स मधुमान्
lines_iast: śuciḥ pāvaka ucyate somaḥ sutaḥ sa madhumān

words.gloss: for the feast of the gods

hindi: कवि ने देवगण के भोज के लिए भेड़ के बाल से, छन्नियों से अपने को आगे ढक लिया है; सब प्रतिद्वन्द्वियों पर विजय पाने वाला।
english: Forth the seer, for the feast of the gods, has wrapped himself with sheep's fleece, with strainers; overcoming all rivals.
notes: avyā and avyata are uncertain (avyā read as the instrumental 'with the fleece', avyata as aorist of √vye 'cover'); the sense 'has wrapped himself' is tentative. The subject kavi is not named further.

words.gram: ind. (sma with Vedic ṣ and lengthening)
m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √pū

hindi: वह शुद्ध होता हुआ निश्चय ही स्तोताओं के लिए गौओं से युक्त, हजार गुना वाज लाता है।
english: Indeed he, the clarifying one, brings to the singers the prize rich in cows, thousandfold.
notes: gomat is not split at -mat. invati rendered 'brings' (√inv 'urge, drive').
lines_deva: स हि ष्मा जरितृभ्य आ वाजं गोमन्तमिन्वति
lines_iast: sa hi ṣmā jaritṛbhya ā vājaṃ gomantaminvati

hindi: सब के चारों ओर तुम मन से शुद्ध किए जाते हो, विचार से शुद्ध होकर बहते हो। वह, हे सोम, हमारे लिए कीर्ति पाओ।
english: Around all, with mind you are cleansed, with thought you flow clear. That one, O Soma, find fame for us.
notes: pari viśvāni is elliptical ('around all [things]'); kept literal. vidaḥ is an injunctive used as imperative, as in the glossary rendering 'find'.
lines_deva: परि विश्वानि चेतसा मृज्यसे पवसे मती
lines_iast: pari viśvāni cetasā mṛjyase pavase matī

hindi: बहो, हे महान यश वाले, उदार जनों के लिए स्थिर धन; स्तोताओं के लिए पोषण लाओ।
english: Flow toward, O one of great glory, firm wealth for the bountiful ones; bring refreshment for the singers.
notes: The construction abhi arṣa ... rayim is elliptical: wealth is the thing brought by the flowing. maghavat is not split at -vat in 'maghavadbhyaḥ'.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. mid. √pū

hindi: तुम राजा के समान उत्तम व्रत वाले, हे सोम, तुमने स्तुतियों में प्रवेश किया है; शुद्ध होते हुए, हे वाहक, हे अद्भुत।
english: You, like a king, of good ordinance, have entered the songs, O Soma; being purified, O bearer, O wonderful one.
notes: vahni is rendered 'bearer' (carrier); it is also an epithet of Agni, but the line does not say so.

words.gram: m. nom. sg. (compound duṣ + tara; adjective)
m. nom. sg. pres. part. pass. √mṛj

hindi: वह वाहक जलों में पार करने में कठिन, दोनों हाथों में शुद्ध किया जाता हुआ; और सोम पात्रों में बैठता है।
english: He, the bearer, hard to overcome in the waters, being cleansed in the two hands; and Soma sits in the vessels.
notes: duṣṭara could also be 'hard to cross'. gabhastyoḥ is a dual locative or genitive ('in/of the two hands').

hindi: खेलने वाले, मख के समान उदार, हे सोम, तुम छन्ने के पास जाते हो; स्तोता को उत्तम वीरता देते हुए।
english: Playful, generous like Makha, you go to the filter, O Soma, bestowing good heroism on the singer.
notes: makha is kept as the name Makha (glossary); other senses ('vigorous', 'festive') are possible. 'to the filter' for pavitram acc. without a preposition.
lines_deva: क्रीडुर्मखो न मँहयुः पवित्रँ सोम गच्छसि
lines_iast: krīḍurmakho na ma~hayuḥ pavitra~ soma gacchasi

hindi: हमारे लिए रस से जौ पर जौ, पुष्ट पर पुष्ट, चारों ओर बहो; और, हे सोम, सब सौभाग्य।
english: For us, with juice, barley after barley, each thriving one, flow around; and all good fortunes, O Soma.
notes: The repeated words are distributive. The object of 'flow around' is left as printed (the second line adds 'and all good fortunes').
lines_deva: यवंयवं नो अन्धसा पुष्टंपुष्टं परि स्रव
lines_iast: yavaṃyavaṃ no andhasā puṣṭaṃpuṣṭaṃ pari srava

hindi: हे बूँद, जैसे तुम्हारी स्तुति है, जैसे रस का तुम्हारा जन्म है, प्रिय कुशासन पर बैठो।
english: O drop, as your praise is, as your birth is, of the juice, sit down on the dear sacred grass.
notes: The two yathā clauses have no stated correlative; read as 'in the way of'. jātam andhasaḥ taken as 'birth of the juice'.
lines_deva: इन्दो यथा तव स्तवो यथा ते जातमन्धसः
lines_iast: indo yathā tava stavo yathā te jātamandhasaḥ

hindi: और हमारे लिए, हे गौओं को पाने वाले, घोड़ों को पाने वाले, हे सोम, रस से शुद्ध होकर बहो, सबसे शीघ्र दिनों में।
english: And for us, O finder of cows, finder of horses, flow clear with the juice, O Soma, in the swiftest days.
notes: makṣūtama is not split at -tama; the instrumental plural of 'days' is rendered 'in', the sense of time within which. aśva-vit is in apposition to go-vit (voc.).

hindi: जो जीतता है, जीता नहीं जाता, पास जाकर शत्रु को मारता है, वह शुद्ध होकर बहो, हे हजारों को जीतने वाले।
english: He who overpowers, is not overpowered, strikes the enemy having approached, that one, flow clear, O winner of thousands.
notes: sa pavasva: the demonstrative sa is rendered 'that one' (वह) here and in the other 'sa ... pavasva/arṣa' lines; it picks up yaḥ.
lines_deva: यो जिनाति न जीयते हन्ति शत्रुमभीत्य
lines_iast: yo jināti na jīyate hanti śatrumabhītya

hindi: हे बूँदो, तुम्हारी जो मधु टपकाने वाली धाराएँ सहायता के लिए छोड़ी गईं, उनसे छन्ने पर बैठो।
english: Which streams of yours, dripping honey, O drops, were sent forth for help, with those sit on the filter.

text_flags.why: Possible: 'inda' is not a case form of indu; the plural indavaḥ (indava ūtaye) would be expected, so a syllable seems lost. The printed text is kept.

notes: Reading of 'inda' as indavaḥ (voc. 'O drops'). If indavaḥ is instead the nominative subject, the sentence would read 'the drops released those streams'. The case of indavaḥ is therefore uncertain. Also possible is a vocative 'indo ūtaye', which would be metrically short. A plural vocative (indavaḥ) next to the singular imperative āsadaḥ is awkward; a nominative indavaḥ (the drops as subject) remains possible.

words.gram: n. acc. pl. adj. (Vedic -ā, form uncertain)

hindi: वह इन्द्र के पीने के लिए बहो, भेड़ के बालों की छन्नियों के आर-पार, ऋत के स्थान पर बैठते हुए।
english: That one, flow for Indra to drink, across the strainers of sheep's fleece, sitting down in the seat of truth.
notes: avyayā read as the Vedic -ā form of the neuter plural qualifying vārāṇi; compare vāre avyaye in 658 (p04/ch01). yonim ā sīdan = 'sitting down in the seat'.

hindi: तुम, हे सोम, अंगिरसों के लिए सबसे मधुर, चारों ओर बहो; चौड़ा स्थान पाने वाले, घी, दूध।
english: You, O Soma, sweetest, flow around for the Aṅgirases; finder of wide room, ghee, milk.
notes: Aṅgirases kept as a name, no role added. 'ghṛtam payaḥ' stand without a verb of their own; kept literal.
lines_deva: त्वँ सोम परि स्रव स्वादिष्ठो अङ्गिरोभ्यः
lines_iast: tva~ soma pari srava svādiṣṭho aṅgirobhyaḥ

hindi: तुम्हारी शोभाएँ वर्षा की बिजलियों के समान, अग्नि की, उषाओं के आने के समान दिखाई देती हैं। जब ओषधियों पर और वनों पर छोड़े जाते हो, तब स्वयं चारों ओर समेटते हो, भोजन मुख में।
english: Your splendours, like the lightnings of the rainy, of Agni, appear like the goings of the Dawns. When let loose upon the plants and the woods, you yourself gather around, food in the mouth.
notes: Syntax of line a is uncertain: tava (your) and agneḥ (of Agni) both stand with śriyaḥ/vidyutaḥ; varṣyasya has no noun ('of the rainy [cloud]' is not stated). cikitre is the verb 'appears' (cikitra by sandhi before u-). Line b: pari cinuṣe 'gather around' and annam āsani 'food in the mouth' are uncertain. abhisṛṣṭaḥ with acc. oṣadhīḥ vanāni 'let loose upon'. Low confidence.
lines_deva: यदोषधीरभिसृष्टो वनानि च परि स्वयं चिनुषे अन्नमासनि
lines_iast: yadoṣadhīrabhisṛṣṭo vanāni ca pari svayaṃ cinuṣe annamāsani

words.gram: m. gen. sg. pres. part. √dah (desid. form)

hindi: वायु से प्रेरित, उकसाए हुए, इच्छाओं के अनुसार, उत्सुकता से, जब भोजनों में सक्रिय होते हुए तुम अलग खड़े होते हो। तुम्हारी सेनाएँ, हे अग्नि, रथ खींचने वाले घोड़ों के समान अलग-अलग प्रयत्न करती हैं, अजर के, जलाने वाले के।
english: Urged by the wind, impelled, according to desires, eagerly, when, being active among foods, you stand apart. Your hosts, O Agni, strive apart like chariot-horses, of the ageless burning one.

text_flags.why: Possible: ṣ for ś (pṛthak śardhāṃsi). ṣ is not expected after k, and śardhas 'host' is the word the sense needs. The ँ in śardhā~syagne is the regular nasal of -ṃs- and is not itself flagged.

notes: Line a is obscure: vaśān anu 'according to desires' (vaśān uncertain), veviṣat from √viṣ 'be active', vi tiṣṭhase 'you stand apart / spread'. Line b: 'hosts strive' (śardhāṃsi, n. pl.) and 'of the ageless burning one' (gen. sg. dhakṣataḥ, form from √dah uncertain). The pluta 3 after rathyaḥ is a chant mark and is not translated. Low confidence.
lines_deva: वातोपजूत इषितो वशाँ अनु तृषु यदन्ना वेविषद्वितिष्ठसे
आ ते यतन्ते रथ्यो३ यथा पृथक्षर्धाँस्यग्ने अजरस्य धक्षतः
lines_iast: vātopajūta iṣito vaśā~ anu tṛṣu yadannā veviṣadvitiṣṭhase
ā te yatante rathyo3 yathā pṛthakṣardhā~syagne ajarasya dhakṣataḥ

hindi: बुद्धि को रचने वाले, यज्ञ को सिद्ध करने वाले, अग्नि, होता, विचार में अधिक श्रेष्ठ; छोटे हव्य के तुम्हें समान रूप से, तुम्हें महान जन चुनते हैं, तुमसे दूसरे को नहीं।
english: The maker of wisdom, accomplisher of the rite, Agni, Hotṛ priest, more surpassing in thought; you, of the small oblation, alike indeed, you the great ones choose, not another than you.

text_flags.why: Possible: tavāṃ is not a form of tvām (nor of tava); read it as the second tvām (samānam it tvām). The ँ in agni~ is the regular nasal and is not flagged.

notes: paribhūtaram is read as a comparative accusative; matim as an accusative of respect, uncertain. Line b: the first tvām is isolated by arbhasya haviṣaḥ and the construction is loose; 'of the small oblation' is kept literal. Low confidence.
lines_deva: मेधाकारं विदथस्य प्रसाधनमग्निँ होतारं परिभूतरं मतिम्
त्वामर्भस्य हविषः समानमित्तवां महो वृणते नान्यं त्वत्
lines_iast: medhākāraṃ vidathasya prasādhanamagni~ hotāraṃ paribhūtaraṃ matim
tvāmarbhasya haviṣaḥ samānamittavāṃ maho vṛṇate nānyaṃ tvat

hindi: निश्चय ही अब तुम दोनों की सहायता भी है, हे वरुण; हे मित्र, मैं तुम दोनों की सुमति चाहता हूँ।
english: Even by [unclear] indeed there is now help of you two, O Varuṇa; O Mitra, I seek the good thought of you two.
notes: purūruṇā is obscure (possibly puru-ruṇā 'much-wailing', or a name); left [unclear] in English and omitted in Hindi. vaṃsi is taken as 1 sg. of √van 'seek, win'. Low confidence.

hindi: उन तुम दोनों से, हे द्रोह न करने वालो, हम ठीक रूप से पोषण और धाम पाएँ। हम तुम दोनों के मित्र हों।
english: May we rightly obtain from you two, those ones, O guileless ones, refreshment and abode. May we be friends of you two.
notes: tā vām is rendered 'you two, those ones'; tā is the demonstrative, its exact function is loose. mitrā is read as nom. pl. mitrāḥ ('friends'); a dual vocative mitrā is possible but the sentence 'we be ... friends' needs a nominative. adruhvāṇā: 'not hostile, guileless'.

hindi: हे दोनों मित्रो, हमें रक्षाओं से बचाओ और रक्षा करो, हे उत्तम रक्षा करने वालो; हम शरीरों से दस्युओं को पराजित करें।
english: Protect us, O two friends, with protections, and protect, O good protectors; may we overcome the Dasyus with bodies.
notes: mitrā (dual voc.) is rendered 'O two friends'; it may refer to Mitra and Varuṇa as in the neighbouring verses, but the verse does not say so. tanūbhiḥ 'with bodies' (or 'with persons') is kept literal.
lines_deva: पातं नो मित्रा पायुभिरुत त्रायेथाँ सुत्रात्रा
lines_iast: pātaṃ no mitrā pāyubhiruta trāyethā~ sutrātrā

words.gram: m. nom. sg. pres. part. ut-√sthā

hindi: बल के साथ उठते हुए, पीकर, तुमने दोनों जबड़ों को हिलाया, हे इन्द्र, पात्रों में निचोड़े हुए सोम को।
english: Rising up together with strength, having drunk, you shook the two jaws, O Indra, the Soma pressed in the vessels.
notes: śipre is rendered 'two jaws' (it may also mean 'lips' or 'cheeks'); 'drunk' takes somam camūsutam from line b as its object.

words.gram: m. acc. sg. pres. part. mid. √spṛdh

hindi: दोनों लोक स्पर्धा करते हुए तुम्हारे सामने झुक गए, हे इन्द्र, जब तुम दस्युओं के मारने वाले हुए।
english: Both worlds yielded to you as you contended, O Indra, when you became a slayer of the Dasyus.
notes: anu adadetām is read as 'yielded to' (anu with √dā, 'give way'); the sense is tentative. rodasī rendered 'the two worlds' per the glossary.

hindi: मैंने आठ पदों वाली, नौ कोनों वाली, ऋत को बढ़ाने वाली वाणी को, शरीर को, इन्द्र से मापा है।
english: I have measured the eight-footed speech, nine-cornered, increasing truth, the body, from Indra.
notes: Syntax is uncertain: indrāt pari ('from Indra') and tanvam (acc. 'body') could also be read as 'around the body' with pari mame 'have measured around'. The meaning of aṣṭāpadī ('eight-footed') and nava-sraktim ('nine-cornered') is kept literal. Low confidence.

hindi: हे इन्द्र और अग्नि, ये स्तोत्र तुम दोनों की ओर स्तुति कर चुके हैं; निचोड़े हुए को पियो, हे कल्याण लाने वालो।
english: O Indra and Agni, these hymns have praised you two; drink the pressed, O bringers of well-being.
notes: The pluta figure 3 after ime is a chant mark, not translated. anūṣata (√nu) can be 'praised' or 'cried out to'; abhi 'toward' is joined to it.

hindi: तुम दोनों की जो बहुत चाही गई टोलियाँ दाता के लिए हैं, हे दो मनुष्यो; हे इन्द्र और अग्नि, उनके साथ आओ।
english: The much-desired teams which are yours for the giver, O two men; O Indra and Agni, come with them.
notes: niyut (a team, usually of horses) is rendered 'teams' without saying of what. narā is a dual vocative 'O two men' (addressing Indra and Agni).
lines_deva: या वाँ सन्ति पुरुस्पृहो नियुतो दाशुषे नरा
lines_iast: yā vā~ santi puruspṛho niyuto dāśuṣe narā
